candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 61-62° on Nov 8, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at Chicago (CLIMDW) for Nov 8, 2026, is between 61-62° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will the Republican party win the Senate in 2028?

candidates.title: Will US used cars and trucks CPI for October 2026 be above 180?
candidates.rules_primary: If the US used cars and trucks CPI for October 2026 is above 180, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will it rain in Tampa between Nov 7 and Nov 8, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLITPA in Tampa on any day within November 7, 2026 through November 8, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLITPA can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Christopher Waller as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Christopher Waller is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2033 be above 5.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2033 is above 5.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2033 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2033, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
